overall_assessment: Section extraction works well for Nord: headings are consistent and the codebook sections land in the right place, including OD/AK moved to coursework_requirements. Remaining issues are leftover gate fragments in assessment, dropped intro paragraphs, and Adgangsregulering (unmapped) sometimes holding the only prerequisite text. Most pre-pass flags (boilerplate, short, no sections) are false alarms.

findings.evidence: Det er derfor obligatorisk oppmøte på samlinger. Studenten må være til stede på 3 av 4 samlinger for å få oppmøtet godkjent. Vurderingsuttrykk: Godkjent/ikke godkjent.
findings.description: Pass/approve gate text is split from the Obligatorisk deltakelse / Arbeidskrav item and the remainder stays in assessment. In SAM1007 the second OD paragraph and 'Både OD og AK må være godkjent...' remain in assessment. In the master courses the OD sentence goes to coursework_requirements but its grading tail is left as a stray first line of assessment ('Vurdering: Godkjent/ikke godkjent.', 'Godkjent/ikke godkjent.', 'Vurdering: Godkjent/ikke godkjent. Teller 0/100 av karakteren.'). Gates are not graded assessment per the codebook.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The gate mover cuts at the first sentence or paragraph of an OD/AK item. Items whose text continues in the next paragraph, or after 'Vurdering:' on the same line, are only partly moved.
findings.suggested_fix: In the coursework-gate mover (see #283) move the whole OD/AK item up to the next item label (Oppgave (OP), Sammensatt vurdering, Hjemmeeksamen, Eksamen), including following paragraphs and the 'Vurdering: Godkjent/ikke godkjent' tail. Also move the summary sentence 'Både OD og AK må være godkjent...'.

findings.evidence: Emnet omfatter veiledning til studenten i prosessen med å undersøke og skrive en avhandling innen det brede feltet engelsk undervisning og utdanning, samt en muntlig presentasjon.
findings.description: The page has an intro paragraph before the first heading ('Beskrivelse av emnet'). It is course-specific content (ENG5003: scope of the thesis supervision; MAT5006/MAT5003: 'Masteroppgaven skal være et selvstendig vitenskapelig arbeid ...') but is not extracted. course_content then holds only the generic description shared by all master courses. In ENG5003 the course-specific content is lost entirely.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Text before the first recognised heading is dropped as a preamble (title and course code lines) in the Nord reader or sectionize(), including the ingress.
findings.suggested_fix: For nord, treat the paragraph(s) between the course code line and the first heading as course_content (prepend to the Beskrivelse section, de-duplicating when identical, as in SAM1007 where the ingress repeats the description).

findings.evidence: Opptak til studieprogrammet, samt fulgt emnene som fører til en masteroppgave i spesialpedagogikk.
findings.description: Prerequisite statements are lost. (a) SPD5002 2022: the Forkunnskapskrav text is mapped to prerequisites but no prerequisites row is emitted (probably removed as admission boilerplate), although the 2024/2025 versions of the same course keep similar text. (b) Adgangsregulering is unmapped and dropped, but it often holds the real requirements: MAT5006 autumn 2022 'Matematikk 1, 2 og 3', KRO1004 'KRO1003 - Kroppsøving 1A', and 'Bestått 90 stp. i masterfaget og bestått FoU-oppgave' in MAT5006 spring 2022 and ENG5003, where Forkunnskapskrav is '.' or absent so no prerequisites are extracted. Handling is inconsistent across years.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No pattern for 'Adgangsregulering' in R/section_heading_map.R (unmapped, so dropped). The prerequisites cleaner appears to strip 'Opptak til ...' text in some cases and keep it in others.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Adgangsregulering' to prerequisites only as a fallback when Forkunnskapskrav is empty or '.', or keep its non-admission sentences (course/credit requirements). Make the prerequisites cleaner behave the same for all years of SPD5002.

findings.description: Source Forkunnskapskrav is the placeholder '.', which is kept as the first line of the prerequisites text when merged with 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' (prerequisites row begins with '.').
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Placeholder stripping in .clean_sections() is applied per section, not per block, so '.' survives when another block is merged in.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop blocks that are only punctuation ('.', '-', 'Ingen') before concatenating blocks within a section.

findings.evidence: Det er ingen praksis knyttet til emnet
findings.description: The 'Praksis' heading is mapped to teaching_methods and appended. It often holds only a placeholder ('Det er ingen praksis knyttet til emnet', 'Se egne emneplaner om praksis.') or practice-placement attendance rules ('Obligatorisk tilstedeværelse. GLU 5 - 10 studenter har praksis...'), which is noise or a gate rather than teaching method.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Heading map sends 'Praksis' to teaching_methods unconditionally.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip 'ingen praksis' and 'se egne emneplaner' placeholders from the Praksis block. Move or flag attendance/obligatory text to coursework_requirements, or keep only real practice descriptions in teaching_methods.

findings.evidence:
Oppgave(OP): Skriftlig oppgave, masteroppgave. Gradert karakter A-F. Teller 100/100 av karakteren. Omfang på masteroppgaven: Individuell masteroppgave - 15000-25000 ord, og oppgave som skrives i par 18000-28000 ord.

Selvvalgt litteratur
findings.description: The stray label 'Selvvalgt litteratur' (a reading-list sub-label in the exam description) ends the assessment text. It belongs to reading_list or should be removed.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: A sub-heading inside Eksamensbeskrivelse is not recognised as a heading.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Selvvalgt litteratur' to the heading map as reading_list, or drop it as a label.
